general.title: MOSuite - plot expression heatmap
general.instructions: Create expression heatmaps to visualize normalized gene expression patterns across samples

categories.name: Gene Order
categories.description: Gene clustering and row ordering options

categories.name: Gene Display
categories.description: Gene label and dendrogram display options

categories.name: Sample Order
categories.description: Sample clustering and column ordering options

parameters.name: Count type
parameters.description: The type of counts to use. This must be a name in the counts slot, moo@counts.

parameters.name: Sub count type
parameters.description: Used if count_type is a list in the counts slot. This must be a name in moo@counts[[count_type]].

parameters.name: Sample ID column name
parameters.description: The column from the sample metadata containing the sample names. The names in this column must exactly match the names used as sample column names in the input counts matrix.

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: The column from the counts data containing the Feature IDs, usually Gene or Protein ID. This is usually the first column of the input counts matrix. Only columns of text type from the input counts matrix are available to select for this parameter.

parameters.name: Group column name
parameters.description: The column from the sample metadata containing the sample group information. This is usually a column showing to which experimental treatments each sample belongs, such as WildType, Knockout, Tumor, Normal, Before, or After.

parameters.name: Label column name
parameters.description: The column from the sample metadata containing the sample labels as you wish them to appear in plots. This can be the same Sample Names Column. You may select a different column with shorter labels for display on figures. The selected column should contain unique names for each sample.

parameters.name: Samples to include
parameters.description: Which samples would you like to include? Usually, you will choose all sample columns, or you could choose to remove certain samples. Samples excluded here will be removed in this step and from downstream analysis.

parameters.name: Include all genes
parameters.description: Set to TRUE if all genes are to be included. Set to FALSE if you want to filter genes by variance or provide a list of specific genes for the heatmap.

parameters.name: Filter top genes by variance
parameters.description: Set to TRUE to include only the top genes by variance. Set to FALSE if you do not want to filter genes by variance.

parameters.name: Top genes by variance
parameters.description: The number of genes to include if filtering genes by variance. This parameter is ignored if Filter top genes by variance is set to FALSE.

parameters.name: Specific genes to include
parameters.description: Enter the gene symbols to include in the heatmap, with each gene symbol separated from the others. You can also paste in a column of gene names from a spreadsheet. This parameter is ignored if Include all genes is set to TRUE.

parameters.name: Cluster genes
parameters.description: Choose whether to cluster the rows, which represent genes. If TRUE, rows will have clustering applied. If FALSE, clustering will not be applied to rows.

parameters.name: Gene distance metric
parameters.description: Distance metric to be used in clustering genes.

parameters.name: Gene clustering method
parameters.description: Clustering method to be used in clustering genes.

parameters.name: Center and rescale expression
parameters.description: Transform the expression data before plotting by centering and scaling each gene across included samples. This affects clustering, ordering, and heatmap values.

parameters.name: Cluster samples
parameters.description: Choose whether to cluster the columns, which represent samples. If TRUE, columns will have clustering applied. If FALSE, clustering will not be applied to columns.

parameters.name: Sample distance metric
parameters.description: Distance metric to be used in clustering samples.

parameters.name: Sample clustering method
parameters.description: Clustering method to be used in clustering samples.

parameters.name: Reorder dendrogram
parameters.description: If TRUE, set the order of the sample dendrogram using Reorder dendrogram order.

parameters.name: Reorder dendrogram order
parameters.description: Reorder the samples, which are columns, of the dendrogram by name.

parameters.name: Arrange sample columns
parameters.description: If TRUE, arrange columns by annotation groups. If FALSE and Cluster samples is FALSE, samples appear in the input order.

parameters.name: Order by gene expression
parameters.description: If TRUE, order samples by the selected gene expression values.

parameters.name: Gene to order columns
parameters.description: Gene to use for ordering columns by expression levels.

parameters.name: Gene expression order
parameters.description: Choose direction for gene expression ordering.

parameters.name: Display gene dendrograms
parameters.description: Set to TRUE to show gene dendrograms. Set to FALSE to hide dendrograms.

parameters.name: Display gene names
parameters.description: Set to TRUE to display gene names on the right side of the heatmap. Set to FALSE to hide gene names.

parameters.name: Gene name font size
parameters.description: Font size for gene names. Toggle Display gene names to FALSE to hide gene labels.

parameters.name: Display sample dendrograms
parameters.description: Set to TRUE to show sample dendrograms. Set to FALSE to hide dendrograms.

parameters.name: Display sample names
parameters.description: Set to TRUE to display sample names on the plot. Set to FALSE to hide sample names.

parameters.name: Sample name font size
parameters.description: Font size for sample names. Toggle Display sample names to FALSE to hide sample names.

parameters.name: Group columns
parameters.description: Columns containing the sample groups for annotation tracks.

parameters.name: Assign group colors
parameters.description: If TRUE, set the colors assigned to sample groups.

parameters.name: Assign color to sample groups
parameters.description: Enter each sample group color assignment in the format group_name: color. This parameter is ignored if Assign group colors is set to FALSE.

parameters.name: Color values
parameters.description: Vector of colors as hex values or names recognized by R. Unnamed colors are assigned by factor level order when the grouping column is a factor; otherwise, they are assigned in the order groups first appear in the metadata column.

parameters.name: Group colors
parameters.description: Colors for sample group annotations.

parameters.name: Heatmap color scheme
parameters.description: Color scheme for the heatmap.

parameters.name: Autoscale heatmap color
parameters.description: Automatically set the heatmap color range from the plotted data minimum and maximum. This changes only color mapping, not the expression data.

parameters.name: Minimum heatmap color value
parameters.description: If Autoscale heatmap color is set to FALSE, set the minimum heatmap z-score value.

parameters.name: Maximum heatmap color value
parameters.description: If Autoscale heatmap color is set to FALSE, set the maximum heatmap z-score value.

parameters.name: Aspect ratio
parameters.description: Set the figure aspect ratio. Ratio refers to the entire figure including the legend.

parameters.name: Legend font size
parameters.description: Set font size for the figure legend.

parameters.name: Display numbers
parameters.description: Set to TRUE to display numerical heat values in heatmap cells. Set to FALSE to hide these numbers.
